tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rnams kyi rten gyi gzungs gzhug tshul thun mong ma yin pa 'phrin bcol rgyas pa dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /bkra shis par gyur cig/ na mo gu ru mahā kā la yā/ oṃ āḥn mo badz+ra dha ra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo ḍā ki nī badz+ra pañca ra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo brāh+ma ḍa bar ru tsi ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo su kha badz+ra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn maḥshrar+dha ka ra war+m+ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo rat+na bha dra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo gu ṇa shi'i la ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo ma ti kīr+t+ta ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo ā nan+da gar+bha ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo pu ṇ+yā gra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo kir+t+ta dh+wa dza ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo ā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn maḥsaṅgu ru ā nan+da kir+t+ta ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo mahā t+mā bha dra shrī ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn maḥsaṅgu ru pu ṇ+yā dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo mahā gu ru ā nan+da dh+wa dza ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo a kā sha dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo pradz+nyā dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo mañju gho ṣa a nan+da pu ṇ+ya ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo man+t+ra dha ra wa gin+d+ra ā nan+da rat+na ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo mañju badz+ra pu ṇ+ya in+d+ra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo man+t+ra dha ra kir+t+ta ma ti dh+wa dza ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn man+t+ra dha ra wa gin+d+ra ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya ya hūm̐/ zhes sogs kyi zhal ngo nang brgyud/ yang na 'jam dbyangs sa lo'i rjes la/ oṃ āḥn mo rat+na nī ra bho ga ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo rat+na sa mu tra ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo badz+ra dha ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥn mo man+t+ra dha ra gu ru wa gin+d+ra ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kir+t+ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ zhes pa'i brgyud pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i bla gzungs bri/ de'i rjes la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha warta ma ne/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne tra ya/

ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kā dhā ri ṇe/ ādh+mā ta krū ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du dam̐ṣ+ṭi ṇi/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ nā gāṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūn/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ ham̐ ham̐ḥphaṭ swāhā/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra kartā ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa kyai rdo rje'i rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying rnams bri/ de nas/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu ni shākya mu ni ye swāhā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang / oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de wī ye/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ badz+ra kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa pu tra/ badz+ra ru dra bha ṭa/ badz+ra ru lu rak+ṣa si sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum la sogs pa log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing dpa' bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang /

bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces dang / oṃ sarba bi d+yā swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa bris pa rnams dbu gzungs dang / khyad par gyi gzungs ni/ oṃ mahā kā la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ mahā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ shā sa no pa hā ri ṇe/ e ṣa/ a pañci ma/ kā lo/ ya mi rat+na tra ya ya/ a pa ka ri ṇaṃ/ ya diṃ twam̐/ pra ti dz+nya/ sma ra si/ ta dā/ i dāṃ/ duṣ+ṭan/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kā la ru pa sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la ru pa sa ma ya/ sa pa na dgra bo thams cad tsa tur tsa pur snying la khril sa ma ya/ mahā kā la dgra bo'i srog rtsa la 'ur 'ur/ kā la kā la/ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad rbad/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ mahā kā la ru pa ya/ dhu ma kā ri/ tsan+t+ra kā ri/ sa ma re sha na/ bha sa ni/ bṛ ta mu ki kaur kaur/ ha na ha na/ bha ga bha ga bha ga dha ya bha ga dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kā la ya ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi/ k+ṣe tra pa la ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi/ si ta pa la hūm̐ sarba shā trun khā hi khā hi/ mahā kā la yak+ṣa muta tsa kro dha ya mā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma ri mu ṣa/ muta tsa ya bh+yoḥ mahā kā la yak+ṣa thun bh+yoḥ ma thun bh+yoḥ muta tsa thun bh+yoḥ kro dhaṃ ka ra thun bh+yoḥ mahā kā la ya ma kro dha dgra bo la thun mā ra ya rbad/ mahā kā la yak+ṣa mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ yak+ṣa nan/ pra sha nan/ muta tsa ya nan/ oṃ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ sham̐ sham̐ li shod ded/ a shod ded/ mu rmugs spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥ dhṛka dhṛka ya du pa sha ni sod/ dum̐ shig ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/

ya nṛ ya nṛ/ mon bu dzaḥ mon bu khrag la 'jibs dzaḥ nṛ na rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/ shag shig rbad/ mon bu pu tra sham rbad/ yam rmugs/ ling 'dus/ kham shod pa ya mo dzaḥ dgra bo'i rus la khrol khrol/ gser gyi spu gri a marbad/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭ/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ gsod byed las kyi mgon po ber nag zangs gri can/ dur khrod kyi mgon po gnod sbyin klu bdag nag po gcer bu zangs gri can 'khor dang bcas pa/ srog gi gshed ma bran bdud gshin rje nag po yab yum 'khor bdud mgon bdun brgya dang / gza' bdud bdun brgyar bcas pa/ dam can nag po gnod sbyin/ gsod byed gshin rje pu tra/ bdud chen mon bu bha tra/ dregs byed ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud kyi dmag tshogs/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu/ cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas phur pa grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi srung ma mdzad nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen yab sras/ mus chen rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dpon slob rnams kyi bstan pa dri ma med pa 'dres med 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi gang zag rgyun mi chad par 'byung zhing / de rnams kyi bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don rgya chen mdzad pa'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod cig spyir gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang /

rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las 'gro don dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig khyad par du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dgon gnas che phra thams cad mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / phur pa grwa tshang 'di nyid dang / gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dgon gnas rnams su gnas pa'i gang zag rnams kyang phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing / nga rgyal dang / 'gran sems/ phrag dog dbyen/ skyo ma/ dkrug bcol sogs mi dge ba'i phyogs kun zhi nas/ bstan pa'i yang snying rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi nyams len rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab lhad med phyin ci ma log pa mu mtha' med pa la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas/ chos tshul bzhin du rnam par dag pa byed mkhan 'byung ba dang / de rnams kyi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad 'bad med du 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ bye brag tu rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing / sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa lo zla ma 'gyangs par myur du 'byung zhing / chu bo'i rgyun ltar rgyun chad med pa dang / de dag gis kyang sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'dres med rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa rnal ma lhad med 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / sa skya pa'i dgon gnas 'di nyid mi nyams shing / gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i thabs kho na byed cing nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig spyir yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du lo legs shing skya rgyal ba/ mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad cing mi 'byung ba dang /

dus kyi 'khrugs pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba/ khyad par du dpal ldan sa skya dang / phur pa grwa tshang 'di nyid du mi la na tsha/ phyugs la god kha/ zhing la sad ser ba/ 'bu than pa kha ba la sogs pa'i lo nad thams cad zhi ste/ mdor na 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad las bsrung ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba snyan grags thams cad dang chos dang mthun pa'i bsam pa chen po la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan gyi phyogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrug pa/ skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyid 'joms shing sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i sde dang bstan par gtogs pa rnams la bsam pa ngan pa sbyor ba rtsub par byed pa'i sgo nas do bsdo ba/ phod 'dzugs pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum/ sa 'og sa steng / sa bla gang na gnas pa thams cad myur du tshar bcad nas rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bskyal nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams su gnas pa thams cad rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig mdor na rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dpon slob rnams kyi lus la na tsha dang / sems la sdug bsngal med par tshe mthar phyin zhing / bstan pa la phan nges pa'i rigs rgyud dri ma med pa lo zla ma 'gyangs par myur du 'byon zhing rgyun chad med pa dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rigs rgyud dang bcas pas dbus gtsang khams gsum mnga' ris sogs bod gangs can la gnas pa'i sde pa che chung / skya ser bod 'brog de rnams la 'go ba'i lha srung / mkha' 'gro chos skyong / lha klu 'byung po/ mdor na mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa spyi dang /

bye brag sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen yab sras/ bdag sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rjes 'jug dang bcas pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa dar zhing rgyas pa yun ring du gnas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig gzhan yang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa dus 'di nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis rigs drug gang du skye ba'i las bsags yod kyang / khyed rnams ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan zhing mngon shes/ rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa yin pas/ bdag cag dpon slob phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can du thogs pa med par pad+mo las brdzus te skye ba len nges pa'i phrin las mdzod cig slar yang gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dag pa'i zhing der 'dren pa sogs bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad yid la re ba bzhin 'bad med lhun grub tu gyur nas/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sa skya pa'i bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar 'byams su bya nus pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ maṅga la mastu sarba dza ga tam̐/ zhes pa dregs pa pho rgyud kyi gzungs dang / oṃ e ka dza ti de wa in+d+ra si bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si ka ma la rak+kha si hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li mahā kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ e a ra li hriṃ dzaḥ oṃ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li mahā kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma ma sha trum̐ a mu kam̐ mā ra ya ud man+ta ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li mahā kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma ma sha trum̐ a mu kam̐ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ ro ru ro ru ṭi tsa pā la a shug+me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ

traka rak+ṣa kha mun+t+ra ru lu ru lu/ traka rak+ṣa snying khrag snying bh+yoḥ pu ṭa pu ṭa bh+yoḥ sha sha traka traka mo tra pa sha trum̐ mā ra ya/ mahā rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog tung tung / ka ma la rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog tung tung / gu h+ya rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog tung tung / tri baṃ rak+ṣa tsit+ta srog tung tung / ma ma tsa pur tsit+ta srog tung tung / pu ru tsa lum tsit+ta srog tung tung / ham̐ sham̐ tri sha trum̐ mā ra ya/ yum chen e ka dza ti/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ nag mo gnod sbyin/ sring mo gser gyi spu gri ma/ snang srid kyi ma mo bye ba 'bum sde la sogs pa dregs pa mo rgyud kyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje zhes sogs pho rgyud bzhin bris pa rnams thugs gzungs dang / oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ oṃ ya mā ya swāhā/ oṃ nair ṛ t+yā ya swāhā/ oṃ wa ru ṇā ya swāhā/ oṃ wā ya we swāhā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/ oṃ ī sha nā ya swāhā/ oṃ brah+ma ṇe swāhā/ oṃ pri thi bī de byai swāhā/ phyogs skyong bcu'o/ /oṃ dhṛ ta rāṣ+ṭa ya swāhā/ oṃ bi ru dha kā ya swāhā/ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣa ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ya swāhā/ rgyal chen bzhi'o/ /oṃ ru swāhā/ oṃ i swāhā/ oṃ a swāhā/ oṃ bi swāhā/ oṃ kā swāhā/ oṃ ga swāhā/ oṃ bh+ri swāhā/ oṃ ka swāhā/ lha chen brgyad kyi'o/ /oṃ phuḥ.a nan+t+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ phuḥbā su ka ye swāhā/ oṃ phuḥrak+ṣa kā ya swāhā/ oṃ phuḥkarko ṭa kā ya swāhā/ oṃ phuḥpad+mā ya swāhā/ oṃ phuḥmahā pad+mā ye swāhā/ oṃ phuḥshaṅkha pā lā ya swāhā/ oṃ phuḥku li kā ya swāhā/ klu brgyad kyi'o/ /oṃ me gholkā ya swāhā/ oṃ shī tām̐ sha be/ oṃ rak+ta am̐ ga ku mā ra ya swāhā/ oṃ bu dhā ya swāhā/ oṃ bṛ haspa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ shu kra ya swāhā/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa par+ṇa ya swāhā/

oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā ya swāhā/ oṃ dz+yo ti ke ta be swāhā/ gza' dgu'o/ /oṃ a shī nī yai swāhā/ oṃ kṛt+ti kā ye swāhā/ oṃ rau hi ṇī yai swāhā/ oṃ mṛ ga shī rā yai swāhā/ oṃ a drā+e yai swāhā/ oṃ bu narba pā+ai swāhā/ oṃ a sh+ye ṣā yai swāhā/ oṃ ma ghā yai swāhā/ oṃ pūrba phalgu nī yai swāhā/ oṃ ut+ta ra phalgu nī yai swāhā/ oṃ hastā yai hastā yai swāhā/ oṃ tsi trā yai swāhā/ oṃ shwā tī yai swāhā/ oṃ bi shā khā yai swāhā/ oṃ a nu rā dha yai swāhā/ oṃ dz+yeṣ+ṭha yai swāhā/ oṃ pūrba ṣā dhā yai swāhā/ oṃ ut+ta rā ṣā dhā yai swāhā/ oṃ shra ba ṇā yai swāhā/ oṃ a bhi dzi tā yai swāhā/ oṃ dha niṣ+ṭhā yai swāhā/ oṃ sha ta bhi ṣā yai swāhā/ oṃ pūrba bhā dra pa rā yai swāhā/ oṃ ut+ta ra bhā dra pa dā yai swāhā/ oṃ re ba tī yai swāhā/ sogs rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi'o/ /oṃ bhai ra ba bhai ra swāhā/ oṃ bha swāhā/ oṃ bhi swāhā/ oṃ bhu swāhā/ oṃ bhe swāhā/ oṃ bhai swāhā/ oṃ bhau swāhā/ oṃ bhaṃ swāhā/ oṃ bha swāhā/ 'jigs byed dgu ste dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i sngags rnams bris pa rnams lte ba'i gzungs so/ /oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+ṣa si/ siṅga li/ de wi hūm̐ bh+yoḥbh+rum̐/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi ka ṭa kā ra la/ lam+bhi ta mo tha/ lam+pā ka be ga lam+bha ka bā li/ ra bi ghaṇ+ṭa/ ru tra mā la bi hu re/ tshe da ha ka le/ ha le na ha le/ piṃ bi dza li/ bā me kun+dhi dha ri yam̐/ ma eṃ da hi na/ karti ka ro ṭi/ bi bhī ṣa ṇa dha eṃ/ bā me pu la pā ṇi/ ha ra dho ra/ na ra si ra mā la pā tā la k+ṣiṃ ka ra ka la/ mahā po ta la/ mahā ka la/ shrī ka bi la ki bi la siṃ/ k+ṣe tra pā la/ hā hā ka re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ka re/ pūr+wa bha ṣa bhi um̐/ dzau dzan+ti/ mām+pa bha ta/ phul+la/
